granularity: millisecond-exact: every candidate second is swept across all ms 0..999 (no 1-second sampling, per operator requirement)
search_scope: MAPS + PLUGINS + APPRES paths (124 series from the frozen spec)

plan.ordering: tiers by priority; within tier hour-major (day weight desc, hour density desc) - correlated deploy bursts

grid.api_note: GITHUB_TOKEN ~1000 REST calls/h/repo fleet-wide; worker cadences sized for <=~500 calls/h at 20 workers

v6_superseded.note: v6 (static epochs + per-chunk workflow dispatch, budget 13000 rps) measured ~250 rps/worker AIMD ceiling and ~35s setup per 25s scan; 28.512B candidates at that effective rate is a multi-month campaign. Grid v3 replaces the queue with deterministic packages + persistent harvester workers + a thin controller. v5/v6 history preserved in git (scan-state branch) and in scan/controller.py + scan/scan_worker.py (archived, unreferenced).

provenance: Universe unchanged from v6: scan/spec_halloween_core.json (sha-pinned in the plan), 28,512,000,000 ms-dense candidates across 124 series, window Sept 28 - Oct 1 2021, hours UTC 01-15, tiers h1a-h3c. Grid v3 re-orders tiers hour-major by corpus-mined density and adds: anchor-free direct sweep at 60-120k rps fleet target, inline family expansion (+/-90s siblings, +/-2.5s bundles) on hit, controller cascade overlay (c1/c2 packages), closed-loop budget governor.
